value: Six clusters showed a significant interaction between group (smoker vs. control) and cue (smoking vs. neutral), including bilateral dorsal medial prefrontal cortex, right dorsal lateral prefrontal cortex, bilateral dorsal anterior cingulate cortex/cingulate cortex, right middle occipital gyrus, left insula/operculum, and bilateral rostral anterior cingulate cortex. These regions showed greater smoking cue-elicited activity in smokers and were used in subsequent secondary analyses.
